gaps.sentence: ___ had we sat down than the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner' pairs with 'than'; hardly/scarcely pair with 'when'.

gaps.sentence: The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.

gaps.sentence: He didn't whisper the news; ___, he announced it to the whole office.
gaps.explanation: 'On the contrary' corrects the first statement with its opposite.

gaps.sentence: Please complete the form in block capitals ___ it can be read easily.
gaps.explanation: 'So that' introduces a clause with subject and modal; so as to/in order to need an infinitive.

gaps.sentence: We'd have held the wedding in the garden ___ it had poured with rain.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if + past perfect' concedes a hypothetical condition in the past.

gaps.sentence: ___ his impressive qualifications, he wasn't even shortlisted.
___ the fact that the evidence was thin, the jury convicted him.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite the fact that + clause' converts a clause into the noun phrase that despite requires.

gaps.sentence: He whispered ___ the children wouldn't hear.
gaps.explanation: 'So that + wouldn't' expresses intended (here negative) purpose.
